```{r}
gly_remove_overlap <- bind_rows(overlap_gly_multiple2, overlap_gly_single2)
```
Flicking through these subjects it is clear that there is no glycaemic data outside of pregnancy that means that drugs prescribed IN pregnancy are actually related to DM, so we can remove it all from the calculation of the DM diagnosis date.

Identify those who don't need an update because the unamtched issuedate IS the original issuedate, and then prepare to wipe all others
```{r}

dont_update_single <- single(overlap_update2) %>% 
  left_join(first_update7b %>% select(patid, gly_date, issuedate, pattern), by = "patid") %>% ##bring in the original gly_dates
  mutate(not_gdm = if_else(unmatched_drug_update == issuedate, 1, 0)) %>% ##if the unmatched date is the original date then the original episode was not matched with pregnancy and this is not gdm
 filter(not_gdm==1) %>% 
  select(-priority_1, -priority, -issue_before_gdm, -issueyear, -keep, -metformin)


dont_update_multiple <- multiple(overlap_update2) %>% 
  left_join(first_update7b %>% select(patid, gly_date, issuedate), by = "patid") %>% ##bring in the original gly_dates 
  group_by(individual_id) %>% 
  slice_min(issuedate) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(not_gdm = if_else(unmatched_drug_update == issuedate, 1, 0)) %>% 
  filter(not_gdm==1) %>% 
  select(-patid) %>% 
  fill_columns()

wipe_drug <- no_diagnosis_nor_hes_nor_priority1 %>% 
  filter(!patid %in% dont_update_single$patid) %>% 
  filter(!patid %in% dont_update_multiple$patid)
```

##Now for update 8 
remove the medication and glycamic tests for those that overlap, and update those where needed
also create new variables for earliest ddd and earliest unequivocal ddd, which are needed for update 8 below, note will need to update metofrmin exclude at the end, note now all dates in the updated ddd column should now be context independent and reliable, therefore they can be added into the calculation of the min_unequivocal_date, but we have to be careful how we do this for those with multiple patids - some will already have context-independent codes in there for some patids

```{r}
context_indep_date_single <- single(first_update7b) %>% 
  mutate(min_unequivocal_date = pmin(admidate, ddd, hba1c_date, priority_date, na.rm = TRUE))

context_indep_date_multiple <- multiple(first_update7b) %>% 
  group_by(individual_id) %>% 
  summarise(ddd = safe_min(ddd),
            admidate = safe_min(admidate)) %>% #note some patients have different admidates or no admidate in one patid and one in another so need to unify these to get to a single min_unequivocal date per individual
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(first_update7b %>% select(individual_id, hba1c_date, priority_date), by = "individual_id") %>% 
    mutate(min_unequivocal_date = pmin(admidate, ddd, hba1c_date, priority_date, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
fill_columns()

n_distinct(context_indep_date_multiple$patid)

context_indep_date_total <- bind_rows(context_indep_date_single %>% select(patid, min_unequivocal_date), context_indep_date_multiple) %>% 
  rename(admidate_u8 = admidate) %>% 
  select(-hba1c_date, -priority_date, -ddd)

n_distinct(context_indep_date_total$patid)

first_update8 <- first_update7b %>%
      mutate(issuedate = case_when(patid %in% wipe_drug$patid ~as.Date(NA), 
                                   TRUE~issuedate),  
         productname = case_when(patid %in% wipe_drug$patid ~ "drug removed",
                                 TRUE~productname),
         gly_date = if_else(patid %in% no_diagnosis_nor_hes_nor_priority1$patid,as.Date(NA), gly_date),## if all gly_years matched, wipe all the glycaemic data
         gly_term = if_else(patid %in% no_diagnosis_nor_hes_nor_priority1$patid, "gly removed", gly_term),
         value =  if_else(patid %in% no_diagnosis_nor_hes_nor_priority1$patid, NA, value)) %>% 
  left_join(driver_date_single_overlap %>% select(patid, second_gly, gly_term_u8, value_u8), by = "patid") %>%#the only bit to update
  select(-min_unequivocal_date) %>% #need updating so remove before left_join of updated col
  left_join(context_indep_date_total %>% select(patid, min_unequivocal_date, admidate_u8), by = "patid") %>% 
  mutate(gly_date = if_else(!is.na(second_gly), second_gly, gly_date),## update the gly_date if necessary
         gly_term = if_else(!is.na(gly_term_u8), gly_term_u8, gly_term),
         value =  if_else(!is.na(value_u8), value_u8, value),
         possible_gdm = if_else(patid %in% possible_gdm_pat, 1, possible_gdm),
         equivocal_date = pmin(ddd, issuedate, gly_date, admidate, na.rm = TRUE),
         admidate = if_else(!is.na(admidate_u8), admidate_u8, admidate))


```

##now for update 9 check the diagnostic date driver 
if it is metformin/insulin/a non-HbA1C glucose test, check it is not in the context of GDM 
first find those whose diagnostic glycaemia/metformin/insulin predates everything
else by at least a year 
```{r}
#select subjects whose issuedate is prior to the min_unequivocal date by at least a year (and only bother searching for those that have dates of diagnoses within the window of entry (not worth amending anything for the others)), get all their drugs and make a variable of all those years of prescription up to the unequivocal date, as that is the window we need to investigate

drug_one_year_before_single <- single(first_update8) %>%
  select(patid, ddd, diagnosis, gly_date, gly_term, hba1c_date, issuedate, productname, priority_date, pattern, years, admidate, min_unequivocal_date, equivocal_date, PCOS_GDM_exclude, gdm_status) %>% 
  filter(issuedate < min_unequivocal_date %m-% years(1)) %>%
  filter(is.na(PCOS_GDM_exclude)) %>% #probably none here to exclude
  filter(min_unequivocal_date>=as.Date("2007-01-01") &year(equivocal_date)<2014) %>% ##no point examining those outside those date ranges
  rename(original_issuedate = issuedate) %>% ##so as to avoid confusion with the incoming issuedates
  left_join(all_dm_drugs %>% select(patid, issuedate, productname), by = "patid") %>%
  filter(issuedate>=original_issuedate & issuedate <min_unequivocal_date %m-% years(1) & issuedate < as.Date("2014-01-01")) %>% ##only bother to match values that matter ie at least a year before unequivocal date and prior to end of entry period
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(equivocal_years = year(issuedate)) %>% 
  arrange(patid,issuedate) # so that when they are listed they come out in order


n_distinct(drug_one_year_before_single$patid)
##########################

#for each patid flatten the df so that each patid only occupies one line to facilitate the join with pregnancy obs
drug_one_year_before_single2 <- drug_one_year_before_single %>%   
  group_by(patid) %>%
    summarise(
      equivocal_years = list(unique(equivocal_years))
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(first_update8 %>% select(patid, issuedate, min_unequivocal_date), by = "patid") %>% ##bring min_unequival date back
  left_join(all_pregnancy_obs_update, by = "patid") %>%
  filter(obsdate<=min_unequivocal_date %m-% years(1)) #no point in examining pregnancies codings after unequivocal evidence of diabetes as that is probably just miscoded GDM and no point in matching those after entry period because any issuedate after the end of the entry period is useless anyway

n_distinct(drug_one_year_before_single2$patid) 

#by removing anyone who did not have an obsdate prior to the unequivocal date, we removed anyone without GDM (effectively).  It means that for those that have disappeared by this process, the drug prescription can be kept because there is no strong evidence of GDM

#now get the relevant dates for the pregnancy episodes
  drug_one_year_before_single3 <- drug_one_year_before_single2 %>% 
    mutate(pregnancy_year = year(obsdate),
      pregnancy_month = month(obsdate)) %>% 
    rowwise() %>% 
    mutate(
     match_year = list(if(pregnancy_month <= 6) c(pregnancy_year, pregnancy_year - 1) else pregnancy_year)) %>% 
    ungroup()
  
  n_distinct(drug_one_year_before_single3$patid) #5719
  
  #and see if they all match up during the period of interest (ie issuedate to min_equivocal_date)
  drug_one_year_before_single4 <- drug_one_year_before_single3 %>% 
  group_by(patid) %>%
    summarise(equivocal_years = list(sort(unique(unlist(equivocal_years)))),
              pregnancy_years = list(sort(unique(unlist(match_year)))),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(
    all_years_matched = mapply(function(p, g)  {
      presc <- as.integer(unlist(p))
      preg <- as.integer(unlist(g))
      length(presc) > 0 &&
        all(presc %in% preg)
    }, equivocal_years, pregnancy_years
  )) %>%
  ungroup()
  
  table(drug_one_year_before_single4$all_years_matched)  
  #for those whose drug prescription years don't all match, check if any overlap at all

drug_years_dont_all_overlap <- drug_one_year_before_single4 %>% 
    filter(!all_years_matched) %>%
  select(-all_years_matched) %>% 
  left_join(first_update8 %>% select(patid, min_unequivocal_date, pattern, years, gly_date, admidate), by = "patid") %>%
    mutate(
    any_years_matched = mapply(function(p, g)  {
      presc <- as.integer(unlist(p))
      preg <- as.integer(unlist(g))
      length(presc) > 0 &&
        any(presc %in% preg)
    }, equivocal_years, pregnancy_years
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(all_pregnancy_obs_update %>% select(patid, obsdate), by = "patid") 
n_distinct(drug_years_dont_all_overlap$patid) 


use_first_unmatched_single <-  drug_years_dont_all_overlap %>% 
  filter(any_years_matched) %>% 
   mutate(
    earliest_unmatched_year = sapply(seq_len(nrow(.)), function(i){  ###find the earliest unmatched drug prescription year
      a_years <- equivocal_years[[i]]
      b_years <- pregnancy_years[[i]]
      unmatched_years <- setdiff(a_years, b_years)
      min(unmatched_years, na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  ) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
      left_join(all_dm_drugs %>% select(patid, issuedate, productname), by = "patid") %>% #expect many to many
    group_by(patid) %>% 
    filter(year(issuedate)==earliest_unmatched_year) %>% 
    slice_min(issuedate) %>% 
    slice(1) %>% 
    ungroup()

n_distinct(use_first_unmatched_single$patid)

#for those with all their years matched, find the first drug withi the year prior to unequivocal evidence of DM as we are entering DM territory
drug_update_single <- drug_one_year_before_single4 %>% 
  filter(all_years_matched) %>% 
  left_join(first_update8 %>%  select(patid, min_unequivocal_date), by = "patid") %>% 
  left_join(all_dm_drugs, by = "patid") %>% 
  filter(issuedate>=min_unequivocal_date %m-% years(1)) %>% #find first drug within a year prior to DM (even if all drugs match, if some are within a year of a DM diagnosis they are likely to be part of the DM episode)
    mutate(prioritise_score = case_when(
    !is.na(priority_1)~1,
    !is.na(priority_2)~2,
    TRUE~3
  )) %>% 
  group_by(patid) %>% 
  slice_min(issuedate) %>%
slice_min(prioritise_score) %>% 
    slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() 

drug_remove_single <- drug_one_year_before_single4 %>% 
    filter(all_years_matched) 
```

now for those with a glycaemic tests outside of pregnancy, check that there are at least two dates prior to other evidence of diabetes; for those with an unmatched date, check that there are at least two dates (inc that date).  If there are two such dates, the second is probably when the DM was revealed as DM requires PERSISTENT hyperglycaemia (it is not persistent on first reading)

```{r}

n_distinct(use_first_unmatched_gly_single$patid)

  filter(patid %in% use_first_unmatched_gly_single$patid) %>% 
  left_join(first_update8 %>%  select(patid, gly_date, issuedate, min_unequivocal_date), by = "patid") %>% 
  filter((obsdate <min_unequivocal_date) & (obsdate<issuedate))

#examine the glycaemic tests prior to other evidence of diabetes - below this combines both normoglycaemic dates (showing NOT dm) and diagnostic tests
check_non_diagnostic_single_unmatched <- use_first_unmatched_gly_single %>% 
  distinct(patid) %>% 
left_join(first_update8 %>%  select(patid,gly_date, issuedate, min_unequivocal_date), by = "patid") %>% 
  left_join(normo %>% select(patid, obsdate), by = "patid") %>% 
  filter(gly_date<obsdate) %>% #only bother looking at those where the DIAGNOSTIC value is prior to a non-diagnostic one...
  filter((obsdate <min_unequivocal_date| is.na(min_unequivocal_date) ) & (obsdate<issuedate | is.na(issuedate))) %>% #and where the non-diagnostic one is prior to other evidence of DM because it is after it won't affect the final ddd anuway
  mutate(not_dm_date = 1) %>% #mark out dates that are NOT diabetes
  bind_rows(.,diagnostic_check_single_unmatched %>% select(patid, obsdate, Term, value, gly_date, issuedate, min_unequivocal_date)) #this brings in the values meeting the diagnostic threshold

  filter(!is.na(value)) %>% #effectively just selects those with a diagnostic value as the non-diagnostic test date rows s are NA in the value column
  group_by(patid) %>% 
  mutate(gly_num = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(gly_num ==2) %>% #pick date at which glycaemia is persistent - ie at least two readings so pick second reading
  rename(second_gly = obsdate)

  filter((obsdate <min_unequivocal_date | is.na(min_unequivocal_date) ) & (obsdate<issuedate | is.na(issuedate)))

check_non_diagnostic_single_no_unmatched <- gly_years_dont_all_overlap %>% 
  filter(!any_years_matched) %>% 
  distinct(patid) %>% 
left_join(first_update8 %>%  select(patid,gly_date, issuedate, min_unequivocal_date), by = "patid") %>% 
  left_join(normo %>% select(patid, obsdate), by = "patid") %>% 
  filter(gly_date<obsdate) %>% 
  filter((obsdate <min_unequivocal_date| is.na(min_unequivocal_date) ) & (obsdate<issuedate | is.na(issuedate))) %>% 
  mutate(not_dm_date = 1) %>% #mark out dates that are NOT diabetes
  bind_rows(.,diagnostic_check_single_no_unmatched %>% select(patid, obsdate, Term, value, gly_date, issuedate, min_unequivocal_date))

n_distinct(use_first_unmatched_gly_single$patid)

#now find the second diagnostic date to use for the update
driver_date_single_no_unmatched <- check_non_diagnostic_single_no_unmatched %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
  distinct(patid, obsdate, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(patid) %>% 
  mutate(gly_num = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(gly_num ==2) %>% #pick date at which glycaemia is persistent - ie at least two readings so pick second reading
  rename(second_gly = obsdate)

driver_date_single <- bind_rows(driver_date_single_no_unmatched, driver_date_single_unmatched)

#identify those that had an unmatched date but do not have a second date prior to other evidence of dm, for those we will have to remove the glycaemic data as we don't have evidence of persistent hyperglcaemia
remove_use_first_gly_single <- use_first_unmatched_gly_single %>% 
  filter(!patid %in% driver_date_single$patid) %>% 
  distinct(patid)

#now build the updated dates
gly_update_single <-gly_one_year_before_single4 %>% 
  filter(all_years_matched) %>% 
  left_join(first_update8 %>%  select(patid, min_unequivocal_date), by = "patid") %>% 
  left_join(diagnostic_gly_obs %>% select(patid, obsdate, Term, value), by = "patid") %>% 
  filter(obsdate>=min_unequivocal_date %m-% years(1)) %>% #find first gly within a year prior to DM (even if all gly match, if some are within a year of a DM diagnosis they are likely to be part of the DM episode)
      group_by(patid) %>% 
  slice_min(obsdate) %>%
    slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  bind_rows(., driver_date_single %>% select(patid, second_gly, Term, value)) %>% 
  mutate(obsdate = coalesce(second_gly, obsdate))
#Note we will remove all glycaemic data for those in gly_one_year_before_single4 and replace it with the update above
```

```{r}
gly_one_year_before_multiple<- multiple(first_update8) %>%
  select(patid, individual_id, ddd, diagnosis, gly_date, gly_term, issuedate, productname, priority_date, pattern, years, admidate, min_unequivocal_date, equivocal_date, PCOS_GDM_exclude, gdm_status) %>% 
    group_by(individual_id) %>% 
  summarise(gly_date = safe_min(gly_date),
            min_unequivocal_date = safe_min(min_unequivocal_date),
            equivocal_date = safe_min(equivocal_date),
            gdm_status = first(gdm_status),
            PCOS_GDM_exclude = first(PCOS_GDM_exclude),
            pattern = first(pattern),
            .groups = "drop") %>%   
  filter(gly_date < min_unequivocal_date %m-% years(1)) %>%
  filter(is.na(PCOS_GDM_exclude)) %>% 
  filter(min_unequivocal_date>=as.Date("2007-01-01") & pmin(equivocal_date, min_unequivocal_date)<as.Date("2014-01-01")) %>% ##no point examining those outside those date ranges
  left_join(diagnostic_gly_obs %>% select(individual_id, obsdate, Term, value, hba1c), by = "individual_id") %>%
  filter(obsdate <min_unequivocal_date %m-% years(1) & obsdate < as.Date("2014-01-01")) %>% ##only bother to match those that matter ie at least a year before uneqeuivocal date and prior to end of entry period %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(equivocal_years = year(obsdate)) %>% 
  arrange(equivocal_years) ## so that when they are listed they come out in order


#for each patid flatten the df so that each patid only occupies one line to facilitate the join with GDM obs
gly_one_year_before_multiple2 <- gly_one_year_before_multiple %>%   
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
    summarise(
      equivocal_years = list(unique(equivocal_years)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  fill_columns(equivocal_years) %>% 
  left_join(first_update8 %>% select(patid, issuedate, min_unequivocal_date), by = "patid") %>% ##bring min_unequival date back
  left_join(all_pregnancy_obs_update %>% select(-individual_id), by = "patid") %>%
  filter(obsdate<min_unequivocal_date) #no point in examining GDM codings after unequivocal evidence of diabetes as that is probably just miscoded GDM and no point in matching those after entry period because any issuedate after the end of the entry period is useless anyway

#by removing anyone who did not have an obsdate prior to the unequivocal date, we removed anyone without GDM (effectively).  It means that for those that have disappeared by this process, the drug prescription can be kept because there is no strong evidence of GDM

#now get the relevant dates for the GDM episodes
  gly_one_year_before_multiple3 <- gly_one_year_before_multiple2 %>% 
    mutate(
          pregnancy_year = year(obsdate),
      pregnancy_month = month(obsdate)) %>% 
    rowwise() %>% 
    mutate(
     match_year = list(if(pregnancy_month <= 6) c(pregnancy_year, pregnancy_year - 1) else pregnancy_year)) %>% 
    ungroup()
  
  #and see if they all match up during the period of interest (ie issuedate to min_equivocal_date)
  gly_one_year_before_multiple4 <- gly_one_year_before_multiple3 %>% 
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
    summarise(equivocal_years = list(sort(unique(unlist(equivocal_years)))),
              pregnancy_years = list(sort(unique(unlist(match_year)))),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(
    all_years_matched = mapply(function(p, g)  {
      gly <- as.integer(unlist(p))
      preg <- as.integer(unlist(g))
      length(gly) > 0 &&
        all(gly %in% preg)
    }, equivocal_years, pregnancy_years
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
    fill_columns()
```

#now for update 9 - if subjects appear in drug_one_year_before4, we wipe their drugs and call label them as GDM
```{r}
first_update9<- first_update8%>% 
  #wipe relevant data
  mutate(issuedate = if_else(patid %in% drug_remove$patid, as.Date(NA), issuedate),
          productname = if_else(patid %in% drug_remove$patid, "remove_u9", productname), #logging the removes helps with accountability
         gly_date =if_else(patid %in% gly_remove$patid, as.Date(NA), gly_date),
         gly_term = if_else(patid %in% gly_remove$patid, "remove_u9", gly_term),
         value = if_else(patid %in% gly_remove$patid, NA, value)) %>% 
#update relevant data
  left_join(drug_update %>% select(patid, issuedate_u9, productname_u9), by = "patid") %>% 
  left_join(gly_update %>% select(patid, gly_date_u9, gly_term_u9, value_u9), by = "patid") %>% 
  mutate(issuedate = if_else(!is.na(issuedate_u9), issuedate_u9, issuedate),
  productname= if_else(!is.na(productname_u9), productname_u9, productname),
  gly_date = if_else(!is.na(gly_date_u9), gly_date_u9, gly_date),
  gly_term = if_else(!is.na(gly_term_u9), gly_term_u9, gly_term),
  value = if_else(!is.na(value_u9), value_u9, value),
  possible_gdm = if_else(patid %in% possible_gdm_pats$patid, 1, possible_gdm)) %>% #log possible gdm events for those who have evidence of treatment or glycaemia in pregnancy
  distinct()
  
```

```{r}
 filter(min_issuedate==new_ddd) %>%  #identify those whose ddd is driven by a drug prescription
```

```{r}
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
```

#now for update 10 deal with death date
Some patids have multiple ONS death dates, some have discrepant CPRD and ONS death dates, and for those with multiple patids there is a
greater risk of multiple different death dates
```{r}
#load dates
setwd("YOUR DIR")
ONS <- read.delim("YOUR ONS FILE", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

ONS$patid <- as.character(ONS$patid)

##note some patients have more than one date of death because either a single patid has two ONS death dates or an individual has more than one patid

ons_filtered <- ONS %>% 
  select(patid, reg_date_of_death) %>% 
  group_by(patid) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(reg_date_of_death)>1) %>% #identify those with multiple ONS death dates
  ungroup() 

ons_filtered <- ons_filtered %>% 
  left_join(first_update9b %>% select(patid, cprd_ddate, individual_id), by = "patid") ##add in the individual_id and cprd death date

single_ons_filtered <- single(ons_filtered)

#for those with more than one ONS death date, the cprd death date is more useful
ons_filtered_cprd_present <- ons_filtered %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cprd_ddate)) %>% 
  mutate(updated_death_date = cprd_ddate,
         reg_date_of_death = as.Date(NA)) %>% 
  distinct(patid, updated_death_date, reg_date_of_death)

ons_filtered$reg_date_of_death <- as.Date(ons_filtered$reg_date_of_death)

#if no cprd death date present, use the earliest ONS date
ons_filtered_cprd_absent <- ons_filtered %>% 
  filter(is.na(cprd_ddate)) %>% 
  group_by(patid) %>% 
  summarise(updated_death_date = min(reg_date_of_death)) %>% 
  mutate(reg_date_of_death = as.Date(NA)) %>% 
  ungroup()

ons_filtered <- rbind(ons_filtered_cprd_absent, ons_filtered_cprd_present)
n_distinct(ons_filtered$patid)

##now to update deaths take all ONS and update it with those few deaths
ONS$reg_date_of_death <- as.Date(ONS$reg_date_of_death)
ons_filtered_cprd_absent$updated_death_date <- as.Date(ons_filtered_cprd_absent$updated_death_date)

ons_filtered_cprd_present$updated_death_date <- as.Date(ons_filtered_cprd_present$updated_death_date)
class(ONS$reg_date_of_death)

ONS$patid <- as.character(ONS$patid)
updated_ons <- ONS %>% 
  anti_join(ons_filtered, by = "patid") %>% 
  select(patid, reg_date_of_death) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(updated_death_date = as.Date(NA))# added column so that you can then add updated_ons

updated_ons <-rbind(updated_ons, ons_filtered)%>% 
  mutate(updated_death_date = case_when
         (is.na(updated_death_date)~reg_date_of_death, 
           TRUE~updated_death_date)) %>% 
  select(patid, updated_death_date) 

n_distinct(ONS$patid)

ons_filtered$patid <- as.character(ons_filtered$patid)
ons_filtered$reg_date_of_death <- as.Date(ons_filtered$reg_date_of_death, format = "%Y/%m/%d")


#now for update 10, update the death dates for those patids with discrepancies in their death dates across their patids
first_update10 <- first_update9b %>% 
  left_join(updated_ons, by = "patid") %>% 
  mutate(death_date = coalesce(updated_death_date, cprd_ddate))

#find individuals where death is discrepant AND PRESENT
first_update10_multiple_patid_death_date_discrepent <- multiple(first_update10) %>% 
   filter(!is.na(death_date)) %>% 
   group_by(individual_id) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(death_date)>1) %>% 
  select(individual_id, death_date, cprd_ddate)

n_distinct(first_update10_multiple_patid_death_date_discrepent$individual_id)
 
first_update10_multiple_patid_death_date_discrepent_mode <- first_update10_multiple_patid_death_date_discrepent %>%   
   group_by(individual_id, death_date) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  group_by(individual_id) %>% 
  slice_max(n, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  select(individual_id, modal_death_date = death_date)
  
   
 #now need to propagate the death date for those patids that are missing a death date, and need to bring in the modal death date above in the case that an individual has, say death date A for patid 1, death date b for patid 2, and is missing it for patid 3

 first_update10_multiple_patid_death_date_updated<- multiple(first_update10)%>%
   group_by(individual_id) %>% 
   filter(n_distinct(death_date)>1) %>% 
   ungroup() %>% 
   left_join(first_update10_multiple_patid_death_date_discrepent_mode %>% select(individual_id, modal_death_date), by = "individual_id") %>% 
   mutate(death_date=if_else(is.na(modal_death_date), death_date, modal_death_date)) %>% 
   group_by(individual_id) %>% 
   mutate(death_date_revised = if_else(is.na(death_date),
                               first(na.omit(death_date)),
                               death_date)) %>% 
 ungroup() %>% 
   distinct(individual_id, death_date_revised)
 
  n_distinct(first_update10_multiple_patid_death_date_updated$individual_id)
 
 #now need to update first_update_multiple_patid to contain these individuals with discrepent deaths alongside those with correct deaths
 first_update10_multiple_patid <- multiple(first_update10) %>% 
  left_join(first_update10_multiple_patid_death_date_updated, by = "individual_id")  %>% 
   mutate(death_date = if_else(is.na(death_date_revised), death_date, death_date_revised))
 
 first_update10_single_patid <- single(first_update10) 
 
first_update10_single_patid$death_date_revised <- as.Date(NA) 

 first_update10 <- rbind(first_update10_single_patid, first_update10_multiple_patid) %>% 
   distinct()

 #for later, add in number of gly-tests
 
```

Add in number of gly tests - those who only have 1 and no other evidence of DM will be excluded
```{r}
single_gly_single <- single(diagnostic_gly_obs) %>% 
  group_by(patid) %>% 
  mutate(gly_num = row_number()) %>% 
  slice_max(gly_num) %>% 
  ungroup()

single_gly_multiple <- multiple(diagnostic_gly_obs) %>% 
  group_by(individual_id) %>% 
  mutate(gly_num = row_number()) %>% 
  slice_max(gly_num) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-patid) %>% 
  fill_columns()
 
 single_gly <- bind_rows(single_gly_single, single_gly_multiple)
 
 first_update10 <- first_update10 %>% 
   left_join(single_gly %>% select(patid, gly_num), by = "patid")
 
 saveRDS(firstt_update10, "first_update10.rds")
```
